sources.title: Fusion README.md
sources.locator: Quick start; Core features; Multi-node; Provider authentication; Scheduled tasks
sources.finding: Early-preview self-hosted coding factory with planning/review workflows, persistent tasks, worktree execution, agent mail, desktop/web/mobile clients and daemon-owned schedules/webhooks.

sources.title: Fusion docs/settings-reference.md
sources.locator: Provider authentication; Scheduling; Workflow settings; Per-task budgets
sources.finding: Anthropic subscription OAuth and API-key auth are separate; explicit pi-claude-cli runs local Claude. Scheduling has per-project/system/workflow concurrency, worktree caps, verification cap and retry/timeouts. Usage costs are provider-qualified estimates, not bills.

sources.title: Fusion docs/mcp.md
sources.finding: Fusion configures trusted MCP definitions per global/project scope and forwards enabled servers to compatible lanes. Stdio, SSE and streamable HTTP supported; secret references materialized at use.

sources.title: Fusion docs/task-management.md
sources.locator: Task Creation Options; Duplicate guard; Metadata
sources.finding: Persistent tasks have IDs, metadata, status and configurable workflows. Task create has similarity/exact duplicate guards with explicit bypasses and fail-open limitations. CLI and agent tools share deterministic duplicate handling.

sources.title: Fusion docs/agents.md
sources.locator: Agent runtime; Heartbeat; Task assignment; Inter-agent messages
sources.finding: Durable agents have roles, identity/memory and scoped tools for creating/delegating/assigning tasks, agent messaging and runtime coordination. Engineering backlog auto-claim is opt-in; executor pickup is default.

sources.title: Fusion docs/sandbox.md
sources.locator: Linux bubblewrap; macOS sandbox-exec; Task sessions
sources.finding: Optional experimental OS sandbox backends are distinct from Git worktrees. Default is native; fail-hard or fallback-native behavior is configurable. Writable/network boundaries vary by backend.

sources.title: Fusion LICENSE
sources.finding: MIT source license at the pinned revision.

sources.title: Fusion v0.78.0-beta.9
sources.finding: Beta release published 23 October 2026. README labels product early preview.

sources.title: Fusion homepage
sources.locator: Install section ('Open source. MIT licensed.') and footer
sources.finding: The site presents Fusion as open source under MIT and shows no pricing.

sources.title: Fusion README
sources.locator: Features table 'Any model'; provider authentication list; License
sources.finding: Fusion works with many model providers and local runtimes via the user's own API keys or logins; the README calls it MIT open source and states no price.

sources.title: Fusion LICENSE
sources.finding: The MIT license grants permission to use, copy, modify and distribute the software free of charge.

sources.title: Fusion MOBILE.md: PWA installation
sources.locator: MOBILE.md lines 61-77 (PWA Installation) and README.md lines 318-320, commit eb7eef4
sources.finding: The dashboard ships a PWA manifest and service worker; users install it from Chrome (Install app) or iOS Safari (Add to Home Screen) over HTTPS. The README presents the installable PWA beside the Capacitor iOS and Android apps for steering runs from a phone.

sources.title: Fusion release v0.77.0 assets
sources.locator: Release v0.77.0 (2026-09-02, tag commit a830cde) asset list
sources.finding: The latest stable release attaches Windows x64 desktop installers, an Android APK and fn CLI binaries for Linux and Windows; it attaches no macOS or Linux desktop build and no iOS build.

sources.title: Fusion Antigravity support at v0.77.0
sources.finding: Fusion v0.77.0 explicitly hides deprecated Google Gemini CLI and Antigravity model-provider entries. That provider restriction does not establish whether Fusion can run the Antigravity coding harness.
